propPlay.writeup:
Chelsea Gray has cleared 2+ rebounds in 85% of her 47 games this season, and is riding a 15-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 100% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 3.3 rebounds on the season (5 across her last 5) — the 2+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -590 at BetRivers.

Natasha Howard has cleared 6+ points in 98% of her 47 games this season, and is riding a 46-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 100% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 14.2 points on the season (12.8 across her last 5) — the 6+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -625 at Caesars.

Two legs from two different games at a combined -280 — each leg stands on its own record, and neither result can drag the other down.
